episodes.synopsis: In a world where businesses make bank through dungeons and battles, Minato is thrown in charge of a small company by his childhood friend-turned-secretary.
episodes.title: Induction as President

episodes.synopsis: Kibou Company is strapped for cash and their only hope gathers dust in a museum. In order to get it, they'll have to go for broke and compete in a taxing contest.
episodes.title: Inheritance

episodes.synopsis: While delving deeper into the dungeon and racing onwards towards their goal, Kibou Company encounters the unexpected and must fight to reach the finish.
episodes.title: Order Contest

episodes.synopsis: An arrogant, little wizard by the name of Marika discovers a map which entices the crew on a treasure hunt in search of the most precious treasure of all.
episodes.title: Treasure Hunt

episodes.synopsis: President Minato visits Marika to fetch a form, but then everything goes amiss. There's trouble brewing in Gatepia and it has already claimed a first victim.
episodes.title: New Employee

episodes.synopsis: Kibou Company explores the strange, new dungeon in hopes of earning enough to obtain the old man's legacy. However, it's a trial for them in more ways than one.
episodes.title: Business Goals

episodes.synopsis: Minato bonds with Guide while tackling a mountain of paperwork. Later, Akari finally opens up to Minato and asks a very embarrassing question.
episodes.title: Interim Report

episodes.synopsis: After hearing rumors about a new species of maju that's able to talk, Makoto is unable to contain his excitement but his actions put the party in danger.
episodes.title: New Species Discovered

episodes.synopsis: Makoto's newfound friend had a gash on her leg and he's worried what that might mean. Now he's desperate and determined to find Mineko before it's too late.
episodes.title: Knight in Shining Armor

episodes.synopsis: Minato gets to see a new side of Yutoria when the two of them are talked into exploring a dungeon together. Her fighting skills may be sick, but so is she.
episodes.title: Corporate Warrior

episodes.synopsis: When a new dungeon seemingly sprouts from the ground, the crew goes on the hunt for kirakuri. But what they don't know is that Minato is hiding secrets from his past.
episodes.title: Business Opportunity

episodes.synopsis: Minato's secret is out in the open but a vicious maju is still on the loose. Will Kibou Company summon the goddess or will their efforts prove all for naught?
episodes.title: Management Fad
